translations.web: Yahweh, you will ordain peace for us, for you have also done all our work for us.
translations.bsb: O LORD, You will establish peace for us. For all that we have accomplished, You have done for us.
translations.kjv: LORD, thou wilt ordain peace for us: for thou also hast wrought all our works
translations.asv: Jehovah, thou wilt ordain peace for us; for thou hast also wrought all our works for us.
